info.name: Bulk Action Platform
info.description:
Bulk Action Platform API. All endpoints accept and return JSON (`application/json`), including errors, which use the shape `{ "errors": ["..."] }`.

Setup: set the `baseUrl` collection variable (default `http://localhost:3000`). Running any **Create** request stores the new id in `bulkActionId`, which the Get / Stats / Logs / Cancel requests use.

Every request has a saved example response (captured from a running server) and test scripts asserting the status code and that the response is JSON, so the whole collection can be run with the Collection Runner.
